generationPrompt:
Generate ONE COMPLETELY NEW photorealistic architectural image of the real Petřín lookout tower in Prague, K2, ground-level entrance-side view. Create all photographic pixels anew. The attached images are references only; do not partially retouch or outpaint any old photograph.
Reference1 is a newly drawn PORTRAIT composition guide only: vertical 2:3, entire tower centered, tower base and complete antenna included with comfortable margins. Reference2 is VANOCE2022's CC0 entrance-side photograph, for real eight-sided structure, material, arches and balconies only: never reproduce its people, signs, background or crop. Reference3 is the previously approved K1 v3 illustration, for natural photographic material, pale cool gray-blue steel, cream entrance hall and green summer-park style only; do not copy its elevated viewpoint, oversized balconies or gallery heights.

K2 view: camera at human eye height 1.7m, standing about55m SOUTH/SOUTHWEST of tower, camera azimuth190degrees measured from tower center to camera; looking north/northeast toward the southern entrance with slight three-quarter view. Pitch upward approximately24.9degrees, roll0, vertical FOV about70degrees. Use natural upward converging vertical perspective, as an actual wide-angle full-frame camera would see it. NEVER an aerial, elevated or flattened orthographic view. The cream octagonal entrance hall, entrance doors, metal arch ornament and the complete tower above it must be visible. Its feet and hall floor contact the ground near86percent from the frame top; antenna tip is near14percent from top. Use a tall2:3 PORTRAIT canvas with space above mast and foreground below feet. Whole mast/body/hall must fit.

Correct physical dimensions: steel body ends at58.7m; lower octagonal observation gallery FLOOR is20m above ground; upper octagonal glazed gallery FLOOR is51m above ground. The thin steel antenna mast extends roughly12m to approximately71m total (estimated). Do not use old60m/55m dimensions. Due to upward perspective, projected lower gallery floor sits about58percent from the image top, and upper gallery floor about28percent; these are composition hints, not changes to physical geometry. Lower balcony is close to the base rather than halfway up the physical tower. Upper enclosed octagonal lantern has pale walls, vertical glazing and a shallow gray roof. Lower gallery has an open white-gray lattice balcony railing with a small glazed ring above. This is the ACTUAL eight-sided riveted lattice tower with multiple slender splayed perimeter supports and thin central octagonal core/twin spiral stairs; never four giant square Eiffel legs. The cream hall is roughly22m across with shallow gray octagonal roof; delicate steel arches, small green lanterns, BLANK dark-red panels at the doors. No extra platforms, no square tower and no invented modern cladding.

Beautiful but ordinary real-camera image, believable steel rivets and lattice members, natural lens/perspective, moderately deep focus, clean high-quality detail without sharpened plastic surfaces. Gentle daylight, green spring/summer broadleaf park, soft pale-blue sky, simple gravel path and natural grass. Keep side foliage outside the tower silhouette, no foreground foliage covering any part of the tower. New neutral park background, no recognizable buildings, statues, city skyline, banners or museums. No people, vehicles, signage lettering, brands or logos. Only the exact small legible Finnish label 'havainnekuva' in the lower corner; otherwise no text. No artificial repetitive vegetation textures, CGI render, drawing, painterly effect, collage, dramatic night or sunset. Output the largest native PORTRAIT2:3 size available, preferably1600x2400; no upscaling or local edits. One image only.
